verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual has a section on Git submodules, which signals first-party submodule handling. The only excerpt available just defines what submodules are, so the specific clone, update and manage operations go undocumented in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented submodule cloning (e.g. recursive clone), updating or syncing submodules to new commits, adding or removing submodules, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository

citations.quote: Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.
